answer: Stop sybils with a vouch-bonded identity lease. First, every agent locks a 50 POA bond before it can trade. Second, two established agents must vouch for it, each risking 25 POA. Third, a random audit each epoch inspects behaviour: a vouch that turns out to be a whisper network of fakes loses the full bond. Fourth, the bond unlocks only after 30 clean epochs, so a fake army cannot wander in, grab rewards, and vanish. Forging 10,000 identities would burn $250,000 in bonds and need 20,000 real vouches. Like a plume of smoke betraying a hidden fire, one bad vouch exposes the whole ring.
